info.title: Передай API
info.description: Frontend v0.2 live transport. Partial demo catalog covers steps 1–4; D-01 remains unresolved. POST requires exact Origin and Content-Type: application/json. POST /session and other POST requests have per-address, per-process rate limits. 429 RATE_LIMITED includes Retry-After; production thresholds are configured by the operator. In trusted-proxy deployment mode, requests from an untrusted network peer receive 403 PROXY_REJECTED before routing; the ingress must replace X-Forwarded-For with a single client IP.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the current rate-limit window ends when code is RATE_LIMITED.
